lines.zh: 我踏着地走过来，地面在颤。
lines.en: I stomp over and the ground shivers.

lines.zh: 我离地半格，重得像要压塌。
lines.en: I float half a block up, heavy as collapse.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，气先压过来。
lines.en: I close in, my ki arriving first.
I swing my arms and stride wide.
I crack the slabs underfoot.

lines.zh: 我故意慢慢走，让你看清。
lines.en: I walk slowly so you can see it coming.

lines.zh: 我抬头看了一眼，又低下头。
lines.en: I glance up once, then look down again.
I come around the far side of the hill.

lines.zh: 我的手插在腰上，走得很稳。
lines.en: Hands on my hips, I walk steady.

lines.zh: 我这一身肌肉不是摆设。
lines.en: This bulk of mine is not for show.
I shove a tree out of my way.

lines.zh: 我离你越来越近，气越来越重。
lines.en: I draw closer, my ki growing heavier.
I stand with folded arms, unimpressed.
My aura spirals slowly around me.

lines.zh: 我哼了一声，鼻孔出了气。
lines.en: I snort and my nostrils flare.

lines.zh: 我抬头看天，像在等什么。
lines.en: I look up as if waiting for something.
I crack my knuckles.
I stand and the soil sinks under me.
I say nothing and laugh first.
I wait for your ki to rise.
I stand straight, not a hair moving.
I am estimating how many hits you need.

lines.zh: 我呼一口气，地面扬起灰。
lines.en: I exhale and dust kicks up.
I cannot even be bothered to widen my eyes.

lines.zh: 我把气收了收，又放出来。
lines.en: I pull my ki in, then let it out.

lines.zh: 我歪头，掂量你几斤几两。
lines.en: I tilt my head, weighing what you are worth.
I smile, and it is ugly.

lines.zh: 我抬起一根手指朝你点了点。
lines.en: I raise one finger and point at you.

lines.zh: 你这种气量也敢站在我面前。
lines.en: With ki like that you still stand before me.
I do not look away.
I see exactly what armor you wear.
I slowly lower my stance.

lines.zh: 我的气在你周围转了圈。
lines.en: My ki circles around you.
I speak, and my voice is deep.
I am waiting for you to run.
I lift my chin and bare my teeth.

lines.zh: 我把拇指从腰带上拿下。
lines.en: I take my thumb off my belt.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里好下手。
lines.en: I stare at your knees; they look easy.
I nod, as if confirming something.
I only watch, unworried.

lines.zh: 我一脚把石块踢到你脚边。
lines.en: I kick a stone to your feet.
I grunt once.
I step back and the ground cracks.
A cut opens on my face.
I raise my ki to smother the pain.
I grit my teeth and hold.
I did not expect you to land that.
My chest heaves.
I snort, thoroughly unconvinced.
I glance at that little thing.
That is not worth my trouble.
I wave it off like a fly.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，嚼两下就吐了。
lines.en: I bite, chew twice, and spit it out.
I would rather take your life.

lines.zh: 这点吃的，还不够我一口。
lines.en: That food isn't even one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我要的是战斗，不是吃的。
lines.en: I want a fight, not food.

lines.zh: 我踩了一脚，把它碾进土里。
lines.en: I step on it and grind it into the dirt.
You cannot buy anything with that.
You hit me like a mountain.
One shoulder check sends you four blocks.

lines.zh: 我几乎没动，地动了一下。
lines.en: I barely move; the ground does.
My backhand swats you aside.

lines.zh: 我们的气撞在一起响了。
lines.en: Our ki clashes with a crack.

lines.zh: 我低头看了眼被你碰到的地方。
lines.en: I glance at where you touched me.
You bounce off and flatten the grass.
I lift a foot and you scramble clear.
Our impact leaves a pit.
I laugh; I am not angry.
We stand together on the hilltop.
I clap her shoulder, loudly.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了一眼就懂。
lines.en: One glance and we understand.
Our ki settles at the same time.

lines.zh: 我把手臂搭在她的背后。
lines.en: I rest my arm behind her back.

lines.zh: 我们一起抬手指向远处。
lines.en: We point into the distance together.
We laugh, equally unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我的气顶着她的气，不冲突。
lines.en: My ki meets hers and does not clash.
We stand side by side, neither flinching.
We stomp once, together.

lines.zh: 我单手拎起一整块石头。
lines.en: I lift a whole boulder one-handed.

lines.zh: 我把东西捏在手里转了转。
lines.en: I roll it in my fingers.
I pick it up without looking.
I crush it and toss it aside.
I shoulder it easily.
I weigh it and find it light.
I pick it up and toss it twice.

lines.zh: 我一只手就把它捏住了。
lines.en: One hand is all it takes to pinch it.
I grab it, and the dirt shakes off.

lines.zh: 我拎起来，随手抛了两下。
lines.en: I lift it and toss it twice.
My ki surges.
I have finally found you.
I open my fist, ready.
I take half a step forward.

lines.zh: 你身上有我要找的味道。
lines.en: You carry the scent I was looking for.
I grin and show my teeth.

lines.zh: 我不再探你的气，我要打了。
lines.en: I stop probing your ki; I am going to fight.
I raise my hand and my palm glows.

lines.zh: 我先踏出半步，地已陷了。
lines.en: I take half a step; the ground already sinks.
This area belongs to me now.

lines.zh: 我认出你是那次的那个。
lines.en: I recognize you from before.
I step; the ground gives.

lines.zh: 我看向你，也看向你同伴。
lines.en: I look at you, and at your companions.
The corner of my mouth keeps rising.
I am gathering power.
I keep walking at you, never stopping.
Wherever you run, I press in.
I lock your position with my ki.
I hear every one of your steps.
I am deciding which side to smash from.
I swat a tree in half.
I am not speeding up; I do not need to.
I am waiting for your ki to run dry.
You step back; I close two blocks.
My laugh makes you tenser.

lines.zh: 我把脚下的地都踩翻了。
lines.en: I churn the ground as I come.
I raise my palm; light gathers there.
I have counted all your companions.
I am not winded; you are.
My shadow covers you.
You run; I walk.
Only two blocks separate us.
I slam a palm into your chest.
My fist comes down wrapped in ki.
I swing my arm across.
I kick a pit into the ground.
I grab your shoulder and throw you.
I do not strike fast, but heavy.
The impact rings in your ears.
My backhand cracks across your face.
I laugh and add another blow.

lines.zh: 我的气顺着拳头灌过去。
lines.en: Ki pours through my fist.

lines.zh: 你挡住一下，第二下没挡住。
lines.en: You block once; not the second.
My blow leaves a round crater.
I raise a knee into your gut.

lines.zh: 你飞出去，压断了一片草。
lines.en: You fly back and flatten the grass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢收手，等你站起来。
lines.en: I lower my hand and wait for you to rise.
That one will stay with you.
The sky dims for a moment; I have arrived.
I form out of the aura, very tall.
You hear an explosion far off.
My ki pushes the clouds aside first.
Someone stands on the far hill.
This place suddenly feels cramped.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，骨节连响。
lines.en: I stretch and my joints pop.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷在上方鼓起来。
lines.en: My cape billows overhead.
I crash down and leave a crater.
Standing, I am taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 我看了看四周，像在挑地方。
lines.en: I look around as if picking a spot.
Even the wind has stopped.
I shake the dirt off my shoulders.
Someone starts running in the distance.
I appear without a greeting.
The birds here have all gone quiet.
One step and I am here.

lines.zh: 火焰烧焦了我的背心，烫。
lines.en: The fire scorches my vest, and it stings.

lines.zh: 水堵住我的鼻子，我咳了两声。
lines.en: Water plugs my nose and I cough.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我胳膊，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my arm like a thorn.
That force knots my ki.
Hunger slows my swings.
Lightning makes me jerk all over.

lines.zh: 下面没有地，我整块掉下去。
lines.en: There is no ground below; I drop whole.
